mainEntity.name: How long does the custom cabinetry process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The custom cabinetry process typically takes 6 to 12 weeks from initial design consultation to final installation, though this can vary based on project complexity and material availability. The timeline involves several stages: design finalization, material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and installation. Complex designs, specialized materials, or extensive custom features will extend the fabrication period. For projects in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville, our team provides a detailed project schedule during the initial planning phase, allowing you to understand the estimated timeline for your specific project.
